name: Vaultway Shadow
languages: Understands Common and one language from its creation but can't speak
description: Emerging from the deepest recesses of the Abandoned Vaultways, the Vaultway Shadow is a spectral wraith born of warped magic and lost souls trapped beneath ancient stone. Its form is a shifting silhouette of smoke-thin darkness, constantly flickering and stretching as if trying to dissolve into the shadows themselves. Jagged edges ripple like torn fabric, and faint, ghostly wisps trail behind it, leaving a faint afterimage that distorts the air. The creature's eyes glow with a cold, pale blue light--soulless orbs that pierce through the gloom, fixating on trespassers with unyielding malice. When it moves, it does so with unnatural silence, gliding with a disjointed grace that warps reality around it, bending light and shadow in impossible ways. The Vaultway Shadow is surrounded by an aura of psychic unease; the air chills, and faint whispers echo, as if the very walls mourn its presence. It feeds not on flesh but on the sanity of those who wander too close, draining warmth and hope with every glance. In the oppressive gloom of the Vaultways, where ancient wards have faded and iron veins twist into grotesque shapes, this entity appears as a living nightmare, a sentinel born from the fractured echoes of dwarven despair and aberrant corruption.
